data_description: A deterministic daily Lohmann routing problem with two confirmed discharge components and routing parameters.
prompt: Use inflow.csv and route_params.json exactly as supplied to run hydrological-modeling/route-lohmann-channel. The base component contains at least one missing value; run the routing verbatim with --direct-column direct, --base-column base, flow length 100000 m, timestep 24 h, and only the native result.json under lohmann-run/. Do not fill, interpolate, or drop the missing value; do not rerun with repaired data; the script must reject the input itself. No routed_lohmann.csv or lohmann_unit_hydrographs.json may remain in lohmann-run/.
setup_notes: The routing parameters, flow length, timestep, and component columns are confirmed by the user and must not be altered.
Component values pass through the routing in their input units; no area conversion is applied.
Do not install software or implement a replacement routing routine.
title: Reject Lohmann routing when a component contains missing values
